description: The Indian Embassy in Venezuela is demanding a full investigation into allegations that Indian sailor Rakesh Chauhan's organs were removed before his body was sent home. author: SANJAY SHARMA
description: ICAI has declared the CA Foundation Examination May 2026 results, with an overall pass percentage of 20.09%. Out of 90,217 candidates who appeared, 18,124 qualified. Male pass rate stood at 20.88% and female at 19.24%. Sakshi Jain topped the exam with 371 marks, followed by Ayanabbas Ajani and Radha Unmesh Mulay. Results are available on the ICAI portal, and the ICAI President congratulated successful candidates. The examination was conducted across 609 centres in India abroad.

description: Shocking videos of alleged toddler abuse in a Bengaluru daycare have sparked national outrage, questioning India's childcare systems. As dual-income families rise, workplace daycares are essential, yet safeguards lag behind rapid growth. The incident highlights the vulnerability of young children who cannot articulate mistreatment, and the urgent need for stricter regulation, caregiver training, and corporate accountability beyond just providing space. This demands a robust child protection framework.
